body:
## What this transfer is

This Tiqets listing (`p1114531`) provides a direct coach transfer between **Rome Fiumicino Airport (FCO)** and **Rome Termini**, the main rail, metro, and bus interchange in central Rome. The service is operated by **Sit srl** (registered at Via Ostiense 256, 00144 Rome, Italy), offering a budget-friendly highway coach alternative to the Leonardo Express train or metered airport taxis.

## Route options and inclusions

When read on 29 October 2026, the listing offers two directional options in checkout:

- **Fiumicino Airport to Rome Termini:** Direct one-way bus transfer from the airport terminal zone into central Rome.
- **Rome Termini to Fiumicino Airport:** Direct one-way bus transfer from Rome Termini back to Fiumicino Airport.

Both options include **onboard WiFi** and an estimated journey duration of **50 minutes** depending on Rome ring-road and urban traffic.

## Flexibility and cancellation

The listing states that **free cancellation options** and **rescheduling options** are available during checkout, making it practical if your flight schedule changes ahead of departure.

## What to check before booking

Because road traffic into central Rome can take longer than the 50-minute baseline during weekday morning and evening rush hours, allow extra buffer time when traveling from Rome Termini to Fiumicino Airport for an outbound flight.
